# Nabaperks

> No-app QR loyalty for UK food & drink venues. Customers scan one permanent venue QR, a browser-based loyalty card opens in their phone browser (no app download and no Apple/Google Wallet pass), they save it in one tap, and collect counter-verified stamps. Reach the threshold and they unlock a reward redeemed in-store. Built for pubs, gastropubs, bars, cafes and takeaways.

## What makes Nabaperks different
- A true browser-based loyalty card, not a wallet pass: nothing to download or install, on any iPhone or Android. Most rivals that say "no app" still require an Apple/Google Wallet pass.
- Counter-verified stamps: every stamp is confirmed at the counter against the physical venue QR, the customer's membership, the venue's billing status, a one-stamp-per-customer-per-UK-calendar-date cap, and optional location-anomaly signals. Rewards are verified live at redemption, not from a screenshot. The phone never crosses the counter.
- No POS and no hardware: works on any phone, tablet or till, including cash-only takeaways. No POS or EPOS integration required. A permanent venue QR handles joins, stamps, and rewards.
- Loyalty and marketing kept separate: customers can earn and redeem without joining a marketing list (consent-led marketing opt-in).

## Loyalty for pubs
- Pub hub: https://nabaperks.com/loyalty-for-pubs — reward regulars without an app or a CRM; one venue QR for the bar, the tables and the takeaway hatch.

## Loyalty by venue type
- Cafes & coffee shops: https://nabaperks.com/loyalty-for-cafes — turn the daily-habit visit into counter-verified stamps; no app, no queue at the till.
- Takeaways: https://nabaperks.com/loyalty-for-takeaways — works on any till, even cash-only; no POS to buy and nothing to type at the counter.
- Bars & wine bars: https://nabaperks.com/loyalty-for-bars — give regulars a reason to choose your bar again; nothing to lose between rounds.

## Pricing
- 30-day free pilot, then £49/month per venue (GBP), or £490/year billed yearly (two months free). No contract.
- Build the card and preview the QR flow for free; billing starts only when the live venue QR is activated.

## Operator
- Nabaperks is operated by Lapen Inns, a hospitality operator running 9 pubs across England.
- Public contact and privacy/data contact: info@lapeninns.com.

## First-party proof — the Nabaperks Counter-Loyalty Index
- Methodology: Nabaperks first-party loyalty data from UK food-and-drink venues, March 2024 to June 2026. Snapshot as of June 2026.
- 1,842 loyalty members; 812 stamped in the last three months; 1,180 of 2,934 rewards redeemed; 46.8% of members return.
- Calculated from first-party loyalty records. Measured across Nabaperks-powered venues.
